title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
authors: Botao He, Yiming Dou, Yiannis Aloimonos, Jitendra Malik, Akash Sharma, Ruoshi Liu

tldr.zh: DSP 先用约 15 分钟无指定任务目标的遥操作示范学会“摆弄物体”，让机器人自主交互数小时训练世界模型；执行时由同一 Play 策略提出候选动作、世界模型预测后果、MPC 选择最接近目标姿态的动作并滚动重规划，实现灵巧手内物体重定向，还可将规划结果蒸馏成直接输出动作的快速策略。
tldr.en: DSP behavior-clones a goal-free play policy from about 15 minutes of teleoperation, then collects hours of autonomous robot interaction to train a world model; at execution, the same play policy proposes action chunks, the world model predicts their outcomes, and MPC selects goal-reaching motions and replans for in-hand reorientation, with optional distillation into a fast direct-action policy.

evaluation_scope.zh: 评测 Push-T 平面推动，以及仿真和真机手内立方体姿态重定向；真机使用 Sharpa 右手、22 个关节位置指令，主实验结合本体状态与标记立方体位姿，另有 RGB 输入实验。目标在 MPC 评分时加入，Play 策略和世界模型不以目标为条件；真机流程直接从真机交互学习，不依赖仿真到真实迁移。蒸馏是可选加速研究，不能把仿真中的蒸馏成绩或 PPO 对比写成全部已在真机验证。
evaluation_scope.en: Evaluated on planar Push-T and simulated/real cube reorientation. Hardware uses a Sharpa right hand with 22 joint-position commands; the main setup observes proprioception and tagged-cube pose, with an additional RGB-input experiment. Goals enter MPC scoring while the play policy and world model remain goal-agnostic. The hardware pipeline learns from real interaction rather than sim-to-real transfer. Distillation is an optional acceleration study; simulation distillation results and PPO comparisons are not all hardware validations.
